pages.text: Sunday. Even a lab deserves some style. Put a block of any high-tech material in a $(item)Stonecutter$() for plating, tiles, bricks and pillars - and back again, so nothing is wasted.

Surround a material block with glowstone dust for four $(item)Lamps$(). Most bricks and tiles also come as stairs, slabs and walls.$(br2)Chronosteel, Spacetime Alloy, Cosmic Neutronium, Dilithium and Void Lattice each have a storage block too - which is how I keep the hoard tidy.
